metaphors.title: The dark forest
metaphors.paraphrase: In a hostile wilderness, whoever shows a light is hunted: publishing a result or a conjecture paints a bullseye on your world for anyone's LLM.
metaphors.style_hint: A black forest with one lit window and eyes in the trees.

metaphors.title: Duelling mathematicians
metaphors.paraphrase: Renaissance mathematicians kept methods secret and duelled each other with public challenges; the same secrecy logic returns.

metaphors.title: Artisanal math and electronic music
metaphors.paraphrase: As not all music is electronic, there will be artisanal, human-made mathematics, perhaps under Dogme-style constraints.
metaphors.style_hint: A workshop with a handmade instrument beside a synthesizer.
